mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 74 degrees with light drizzle at City Hall. The moon is in a waning crescent phase, and we have a visible pass of the International Space Station tonight starting at 8:17 PM, rising from the direction of Belleville and traveling toward the Fitchburg and Madison area about halfway up the sky.

There are two major updates for the city. First, the police arrested a former school staff member following an investigation into an inappropriate relationship. Second, road construction continues on Highway M with traffic shifting south this week, while the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is moving forward with bridge replacements scheduled through mid-November.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga, and trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory, plus live music continues throughout the week.

In a report released on September 4, the Verona Police Department confirmed the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson for a sexual assault of a child involving a student, with the incident occurring back on Sunday, August 30.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The Verona Culver's is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM this evening.
